content.text:
I'm stopping the automated checks here. Every verification command needs an approval this session cannot grant, so the file is verified by inspection only. The rewrite itself succeeded.

I rewrote `0.svg` from a bare, empty root element into a well-formed, sized, accessible SVG. The original had no dimensions, no viewBox, and no content, so browsers fell back to a default-sized transparent box and converters that need an intrinsic size could not handle it.

What changed:

- **Intrinsic size and scaling.** Added width, height, and a matching viewBox so the image has a defined size and scales cleanly when resized.
- **Accessibility.** Added an image role plus a title and description that assistive technology will read, with IDs unique enough to survive being inlined next to other SVGs.
- **Standalone hygiene.** Added an XML declaration with UTF-8 encoding and a trailing newline.

The file now reads:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="100" height="100" viewBox="0 0 100 100"
     role="img" aria-labelledby="svg0-title svg0-desc">
  <title id="svg0-title">Blank placeholder</title>
  <desc id="svg0-desc">An intentionally empty, transparent 100 by 100 graphic.</desc>
</svg>
```

One assumption to flag. The original had no drawing content, and nothing in the filename or directory says what it should show, so I kept it blank rather than invent artwork. The square size is arbitrary and easy to change on the root element. If the file is supposed to depict something, such as a digit zero or an icon, that artwork is the one piece still missing, along with matching title and description text.

Blocked checks, for the record: an XML well-formedness lint, a QuickLook render to confirm the output dimensions, and a scan for alternative renderers. All were auto-denied because the session has no approval surface. The file is small enough that I am confident it is well-formed from reading it: every tag is closed, every attribute is quoted, all IDs are valid names, and the text contains no characters that need escaping.
